settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Most orders are dispatched within two business days and arrive within 3–6 business days, fully insured.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Email us within 14 days of delivery with your order number and we'll send a prepaid label.

settings.question: Do you buy pre-owned pieces?
settings.answer: Yes — send us photos and details of your item through the form above, choosing “Selling to us”.
